headline: US Jury Finds Huawei Guilty of Fraud and Theft
standfirst: A major verdict in the trade secret conspiracy trial involving the Chinese tech giant.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: A US jury found Huawei guilty of conspiring to steal trade secrets and committing fraud.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The company faced a series of charges in court. Prosecutors alleged criminal wrongdoing.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: The jury acquitted Huawei of the most serious charge of engaging in a criminal racketeering conspiracy.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: We are waiting to see how this mixed verdict impacts future legal battles for the company.

caption:
A US jury has reached a verdict in the trade secrets and fraud trial against Huawei.

While the company was found guilty of conspiracy and fraud, jurors cleared them of the most severe racketeering charges. This case has been a major point of tension in the ongoing US-China tech dispute.
